argv:
  new-window
  -b
  -t
  =agentctl-launchtest:^
  -n
  improve~golden
  -c
  $PROJECT
  -P
  -F
  #{window_id}
env:
  AGENTCTL=1
  AGENTCTL_AGENT_NAME=golden
  AGENTCTL_BIN=<BIN>
  AGENTCTL_CLAUDE_NAME=golden-improve-002
  AGENTCTL_INSTANCE=launchtest
  AGENTCTL_INSTANCE_NAME=improve~golden
  AGENTCTL_MODE=improve
  AGENTCTL_RUNTIME_DIR=$PROJECT/.agentctl
  AGENTCTL_SESSION_ID=<UUID>
  AGENTCTL_WINDOW_NAME=improve~golden
  AGENTCTL_WORKING_DIR=$PROJECT
  CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC=1
  CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_TERMINAL_TITLE=1
  CLAUDE_CODE_SHELL_PREFIX=$PROJECT/.agentctl/shell-prefix.sh
  CLAUDE_CODE_SUBPROCESS_ENV_SCRUB=1
  DISABLE_AUTOUPDATER=1
command:
  unset AGENTCTL_WINDOW_ID AGENTCTL_WINDOW_INDEX AGENTCTL_BRANCH AGENTCTL_WORKTREE AGENTCTL_TICKET AGENTCTL_TICKET_TITLE AGENTCTL_REPO AGENTCTL_SPAWNED_BY AGENTCTL_SPAWNED_BY_SESSION AGENTCTL_BACKEND AGENTCTL_ACCOUNT AGENTCTL_HARNESS AGENTCTL_PI_PROVIDER
  claude --agent 'golden' -n 'golden-improve-002' --session-id '<UUID>' --model 'opus' --effort 'high' --settings '$PROJECT/.agentctl/settings/golden.json' "$(cat '$PROJECT/.agentctl/launch/improve-golden-<RAND>.txt')"; rm -f '$PROJECT/.agentctl/launch/improve-golden-<RAND>.txt'
windowstate:
  instance=improve~golden
  agent=golden
  mode=improve
  log_path=$HOME/.claude/projects/<SLUG:$PROJECT>/<UUID>.jsonl
  session_name=golden-improve-002
  backend=
  account=
